title: SSRF Protection Configuration
description: Configuration for Server-Side Request Forgery protection in AICP capability executions.

enabled.description: Enable or disable SSRF protection globally.

allow_private_network.description: Allow requests to private IP ranges (RFC 1918). Defaults to false for security.

dangerously_allow_private_network.description: DANGEROUS: Allow requests to private IP ranges without additional checks. Use with extreme caution.

allow_rfc2544_benchmark_range.description: Allow the RFC 2544 benchmark range (198.18.0.0/15). Typically used for performance testing.

blocked_hostnames.description: List of hostnames to block. Supports exact matches and wildcard suffixes (e.g., '*.local').

hostname_allowlist.description: Hostnames to bypass SSRF checks. Supports exact matches and wildcard suffixes (e.g., '*.internal.corp').

dns_rebinding_protection.description: Resolve DNS and verify the resolved IP is safe before allowing the request.

max_dns_cache_seconds.description: Maximum time to cache DNS resolution results for SSRF checks. 0 means no caching.
